Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 115. Category: feat. Trained Feature Feats.

Your Fusion is even stronger than before! Designate a
metamoran fusion that you have become, you gain 50
HP and Ki for the Duration in that fusion. You
automatically pass any checks to fuse into the
designated fusion This feat can be taken multiple times
but can not be used on the same fusion.
